title: "RV2005: Ref-bound local assigned outside ref callbacks"

**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Ref-bound locals must be assigned only by ref callbacks
```

## How to fix

Assign the ref-bound local only inside its ref callback; keep other state in a separate signal, or use const el = `ref<…>()` and `ref={el}`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export function A() { let el: any; return <div ref={(e) => (el = e)} onClick={() => { el = null; }} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
export function A() { let el: any; return <div ref={(e) => (el = e)} onClick={() => el.focus()} />; }
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode.
